sentences.text: Researchers developed a machine-learning tool named THERM-D to continuously and rapidly measure body temperature rhythms in fruit flies.
The study revealed that these temperature rhythms align with morning and evening activity patterns, highlighting a specific group of brain cells that lack the protein CRYPTOCHROME.
By manipulating these CRYPTOCHROME-deficient cells, the team demonstrated that they are responsible for the morning increase in body temperature.
The findings indicate that distinct groups of brain cells manage morning versus evening temperature changes, providing a method to study how the body maintains its temperature rhythm.
